title: Oracle put its cloud rival’s AI inside its business apps, and the stock jumped 8%
excerpt: Oracle has just put its cloud rival’s AI at the heart of the software its customers run their businesses on. Investors cheered. The company said on Thursday it is expanding its Google Cloud partnership to bring Gemini into Oracle’s ente
content_html:
Oracle has just put its cloud rival’s AI at the heart of the software its customers run their businesses on. Investors cheered.

The company said on Thursday it is expanding its Google Cloud partnership to bring Gemini into Oracle’s enterprise applications. Gemini will slot into Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications. It will also power embedded AI across Oracle Fusion apps and NetSuite.

Two models are on the menu. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is tuned for cheap, efficient work. Gemini 3.5 Flash handles heavier reasoning and creative tasks such as video and presentations. Both join models Oracle already offers.

Wall Street liked it. Oracle shares rose as much as 8.4% to $127.64, Bloomberg reported.

Even giants are going multi-model

The logic is choice. Rather than lock customers into its own AI, Oracle is offering Google’s as another option inside tools they already use. It is the enterprise trend of the year: pick the best model for each job, rather than one model for everything.

“Organizations need the flexibility to choose the AI model best suited to each problem,” said Chris Leone, Oracle’s applications-development chief. Oracle Fusion, he added, then turns that reasoning into action “through governed workflows, approvals, and transactions.”

An unlikely alliance, deepening

Oracle and Google compete hard in the cloud, yet their partnership keeps growing, from raw infrastructure to agentic AI. Notably, the model Oracle picked for its app layer is not from OpenAI, its roughly $300bn infrastructure partner, but from Google. Cohere and Meta models were already on offer.

For Google, it is a route into thousands of businesses through software they already run. NetSuite alone claims more than 44,000 customers. For Oracle, it is a fresh selling point as it pours hundreds of billions into AI data centres.

The hard questions are still open

Not everyone is dazzled. The plan “sounds good, but be cautious,” Gartner analyst Balaji Abbabatulla told The Register. “It doesn’t necessarily look as glittery as it sounds. There are challenges under the hood.”

The biggest is accountability. If an autonomous agent makes a bad call at speed, errors can cascade before anyone notices. It is not clear who is liable. Oracle points to monitoring and audit tools. Abbabatulla is not convinced any vendor has answered the question.

For a company wrestling with a heavy AI debt load and a vast OpenAI bet, a stock pop from a model deal is welcome. It also shows where enterprise AI is heading. Even the giants now rent their rivals’ brains, and try to keep a human near the controls.

content_html_zh:
甲骨文刚刚将其云竞争对手的人工智能置于其客户运行其业务的软件的核心。 投资者欢呼雀跃。

该公司周四表示，正在扩大与谷歌云的合作伙伴关系，将 Gemini 引入甲骨文的企业应用程序中。 Gemini 将插入 Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications。 它还将为 Oracle Fusion 应用程序和 NetSuite 中的嵌入式人工智能提供支持。

菜单上有两种型号。 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 专为廉价、高效的工作而设计。 Gemini 3.5 Flash 可以处理较繁重的推理和创意任务，例如视频和演示。 Oracle 已经提供了这两种连接模型。

华尔街喜欢它。 据彭博社报道，甲骨文股价上涨 8.4%，至 127.64 美元。

即使是巨头也在走向多模式

逻辑就是选择。 甲骨文并没有将客户锁定在自己的人工智能中，而是将谷歌的人工智能作为他们已经使用的工具中的另一种选择。 这是今年的企业趋势：为每项工作选择最好的模型，而不是为所有事情选择一个模型。

甲骨文应用程序开发主管 Chris Leone 表示：“组织需要灵活地选择最适合每个问题的人工智能模型。” 他补充说，Oracle Fusion 然后“通过受监管的工作流程、批准和交易”将推理转化为行动。

一个不太可能的联盟正在深化

甲骨文和谷歌在云领域展开激烈竞争，但他们的合作伙伴关系不断发展，从原始基础设施到代理人工智能。 值得注意的是，甲骨文为其应用层选择的模型并非来自其价值约 3000 亿美元的基础设施合作伙伴 OpenAI，而是来自谷歌。 Cohere 和 Meta 模型已经上市。

对于谷歌来说，这是通过他们已经运行的软件进入数千家企业的途径。 仅 NetSuite 就拥有超过 44,000 名客户。 对于甲骨文来说，这是一个新的卖点，因为它向人工智能数据中心投入了数千亿美元。

难题仍然悬而未决

并非所有人都眼花缭乱。 Gartner 分析师巴拉吉·阿巴巴图拉 (Balaji Abbabatulla) 告诉 The Register，该计划“听起来不错，但要谨慎”。 “它看起来并不一定像听起来那么闪闪发光。 背后隐藏着挑战。”

最大的是责任。 如果自主代理快速做出错误的呼叫，错误可能会在任何人注意到之前级联起来。 目前尚不清楚谁应该承担责任。 Oracle 指出了监控和审计工具。 阿巴巴图拉不相信任何供应商已经回答了这个问题。

对于一家正在与沉重的人工智能债务负担和巨大的 OpenAI 赌注作斗争的公司来说，模型交易带来的股票上涨是受欢迎的。 它还显示了企业人工智能的发展方向。 就连巨头现在也租用竞争对手的大脑，并试图让人类靠近控制装置。
